caveat: Upwind and downwind are split at 8 knots over the whole session, so the slow bucket also holds pre-start manoeuvring and the sail out and back. A longer day therefore drags the "upwind" average down on its own — the downwind and peak figures are the solid ones.
note: Only three boats have a log for both days. Team Sweden has 8 September only, so the team cannot be compared day over day.
